statements.status_notes: RUSTSEC-2025-0141 is an informational notice that the bincode crate is unmaintained and identifies no patched release. Milvus 2.6.23 includes bincode 1.3.3 transitively through Lindera for dictionary serialization; replacing it requires an upstream format and API migration and remains under evaluation. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2025-0141.html

RUSTSEC-2025-0141 is an informational notice that the bincode crate is unmaintained and identifies no patched release. Milvus 2.6.23 includes bincode 1.3.3 transitively through Lindera for dictionary serialization; replacing it requires an upstream format and API migration and remains under evaluation. See https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2025-0141.html

RUSTSEC-2025-0141 reports that bincode is unmaintained with no active development or security fixes. The qdrant binary uses bincode for internal serialization of vector data and snapshots. While no specific vulnerability is identified, the lack of maintenance poses a long-term risk. Investigation is ongoing to assess migration to maintained alternatives such as rmp-serde or postcard, but this requires upstream qdrant changes to maintain compatibility with existing data formats.
